target_customer: Active and systematic traders of prediction markets across Kalshi, Polymarket and Crypto.com
problem: Prediction market liquidity is split across venues. Valence offers one interface and unified order book with arbitrage alerts, APIs, historical data and backtesting.
business_model: Trading platform with APIs and data, likely fee or subscription based (not stated)
product_category: Unified trading terminal for prediction markets

founders.name: Neo Wang
founders.background_notes: Source: YC page. Former director of the USACO Guide.

competitors.name: Prediktion
competitors.what: Dashboard pulling odds from Polymarket, Kalshi and PredictIt into one view

competitors.name: Kairos
competitors.what: Unified view and trading across Kalshi and Polymarket, pitched as a Bloomberg-style terminal
competitors.traction_then: Covered April 2026, a few months after the batch start

technical_complexity.rationale: Aggregating several venues, a unified order book and low-latency execution is demanding, but venue APIs are public and the team has trading-firm backgrounds.

defensibility.rationale: Liquidity routing and user data could build some moat, but venues and many terminal startups were building the same wedge.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Kalshi launched a Bloomberg-style interface around June 2026 and Paradigm was reported building a terminal.

market_need_then: The launch post claims volume grew from 7M contracts in September to 250M in December 2025 and over 1B contracts traded; these are company claims. Prediction market trading was growing quickly.

branding.domain_note: Uses valence.trade (.trade TLD, not .com); the host did not resolve from this session, so its state is unknown.

identity.logo: Not described by any source found
identity.voice_and_tone: Founders call it the trading superapp for prediction markets

brand_strength.rationale: A common word shared with many companies, no press about the brand and a non-.com domain; search for the brand returned only directory pages.

outcome_analysis: Valence was a three-founder winter 2026 prediction market terminal with quant-firm founders and fast claimed volume growth. The YC directory lists it as inactive, but secondary profiles describe it as active, no acquisition or shutdown was found and the website could not be fetched, so the cause of the inactive status is not public.
notes: The $500K entry rests on one aggregator (VCBacked), matches YC's standard deal and is stage other. valence.trade failed DNS resolution in this session, so no site content was read. Competitor dates: Prediktion launch date comes from the listing; Kairos source is after the batch start and noted.
